```{r}
# حِزم خفيفة
need <- c("data.table","janitor","ggplot2","stringr","arrow","knitr")
inst <- need[!need %in% installed.packages()[,1]]
if(length(inst)) install.packages(inst, repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")
library(data.table); library(janitor); library(ggplot2); library(stringr); library(arrow); library(knitr)
```


```{r}
source("R/workflow_utils.R")
cfg <- load_moda_paths()
base_dir <- cfg$external_project_dir
raw_dir  <- cfg$external_raw_dir
proc_dir <- cfg$external_processed_dir
if (!dir.exists(raw_dir)) stop("Clinical raw-data directory not found. Update config/paths.yml.")
if (!dir.exists(proc_dir)) stop("Processed data directory not found. Update config/paths.yml.")

# حمّل مجموعة العينات المشتركة
common_samples <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "common_samples.rds"))
```



```{r}
# util: توحيد IDs
std_ids <- function(x){ x <- toupper(gsub("\\s+","", as.character(x))); gsub("[^A-Z0-9_-]","", x) }

# اقرأ الـclinical كـ data.frame بسيط ونظّف أسماء الأعمدة
clin_path <- list.files(raw_dir, pattern="(?i)^Clinical.*\\.txt$|\\.tsi\\.txt$", full.names=TRUE)[1]
stopifnot(file.exists(clin_path))
clinical_raw <- data.table::fread(clin_path, data.table=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","NaN"))
names(clinical_raw) <- janitor::make_clean_names(names(clinical_raw))
```


```{r}
# اختَر أفضل عمود يطابق عيناتنا كـ sample_id
cands <- c("sample_id","sample","aliquot","aliquot_id","experimental_sample_id",
           "case_id","subject_id","tumor_sample_barcode","biospecimen_id","sample_name")
present <- intersect(cands, names(clinical_raw))
scores  <- sapply(present, function(col) sum(std_ids(clinical_raw[[col]]) %in% std_ids(common_samples)))
best_col <- if(length(present)) present[which.max(scores)] else NA
stopifnot(!is.na(best_col))
clinical_raw$sample_id <- std_ids(clinical_raw[[best_col]])

# فلترة على العيّنات المشتركة + إصلاح قيم نصية شائعة
clinical <- clinical_raw[clinical_raw$sample_id %in% std_ids(common_samples), , drop=FALSE]
# خرّط بعض الأعمدة الشائعة لو موجودة
if("tissue_type_0nat_1tumor" %in% names(clinical)){
  clinical$type <- ifelse(clinical$tissue_type_0nat_1tumor %in% c(0,"0"), "NAT",
                   ifelse(clinical$tissue_type_0nat_1tumor %in% c(1,"1"), "Tumor", as.character(clinical$tissue_type_0nat_1tumor)))
}
if("study_organization_0cptac_1icpc" %in% names(clinical)){
  clinical$batch <- ifelse(clinical$study_organization_0cptac_1icpc %in% c(0,"0"), "CPTAC",
                    ifelse(clinical$study_organization_0cptac_1icpc %in% c(1,"1"), "ICPC", as.character(clinical$study_organization_0cptac_1icpc)))
}

# حول كل فراغ/سلسلة "unknown/na" إلى NA
to_na <- function(v){
  v <- if(is.character(v)) trimws(v) else v
  if(is.character(v)) v[v %in% c("NA","na","Na","N/A","Unknown","UNKNOWN","unknown","Not Reported","not_reported")] <- NA
  v
}
clinical <- as.data.frame(lapply(clinical, to_na), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# ملخّص سريع للأبعاد
dim(clinical)

```




```{r}
is_numeric_like <- function(v){
  if(is.numeric(v)) return(TRUE)
  w <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  ok <- sum(!is.na(w)) / length(w)
  ok >= 0.9
}

miss_rate <- function(v) mean(is.na(v))

# ابنِ الجدول
cols <- setdiff(names(clinical), c("sample_id"))
dict <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cols, function(nm){
  v <- clinical[[nm]]
  typ <- if(is_numeric_like(v)) "numeric" else "categorical"
  nuniq <- length(unique(v[!is.na(v)]))
  mr <- miss_rate(v)
  top <- if(typ=="categorical"){
    tbl <- sort(table(v), decreasing=TRUE)
    paste(head(paste(names(tbl), as.integer(tbl), sep=":"), 5), collapse=" | ")
  } else {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
    qs <- quantile(x, probs=c(0.05,0.5,0.95), na.rm=TRUE, names=FALSE)
    paste0("p5=", round(qs[1],2), " | p50=", round(qs[2],2), " | p95=", round(qs[3],2))
  }
  data.frame(name=nm, type=typ, missing_rate=round(mr,3), unique_non_na=nuniq, preview=top, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
dict <- dict[order(dict$type, dict$missing_rate, -dict$unique_non_na), ]
kable(head(dict, 20), caption="Data Dictionary (أول 20 عمود)")
```




```{r}
# قواعد الاستبعاد
is_batch_like <- function(nm) grepl("(batch|center|site|platform|acquisition|ms_run|study_organization)", nm, ignore.case=TRUE)
is_id_like    <- function(nm) grepl("(id$|barcode|aliquot|uuid)", nm, ignore.case=TRUE)

# ترشيح أوّلي
cat_dict <- subset(dict, type=="categorical" & !is_batch_like(name) & !is_id_like(name))

# حدود منطقية
max_missing <- 0.20
min_levels  <- 2
max_levels  <- 6
min_class_n <- 20

check_min_class <- function(v){
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if(length(unique(v)) < 2) return(0)
  min(as.integer(table(v)))
}

cat_dict$min_class_n <- sapply(cat_dict$name, function(nm) check_min_class(clinical[[nm]]))
shortlist <- subset(cat_dict,
                    missing_rate <= max_missing &
                    unique_non_na >= min_levels & unique_non_na <= max_levels &
                    min_class_n >= min_class_n)

# لو متغير type موجود ووافق الشروط، ضمنه في الأعلى
if("type" %in% names(clinical)){
  if(any(shortlist$name == "type") == FALSE){
    v <- clinical$type
    if(miss_rate(v) <= max_missing && length(unique(na.omit(v)))>=2 && check_min_class(v)>=min_class_n){
      shortlist <- rbind(data.frame(name="type", type="categorical",
                                    missing_rate=round(miss_rate(v),3),
                                    unique_non_na=length(unique(na.omit(v))),
                                    preview=paste(sort(table(v), decreasing=TRUE)[1:2], collapse=" | "),
                                    min_class_n=check_min_class(v),
                                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                         shortlist)
    }
  }
}

kable(shortlist, caption="Label Shortlist — متغيّرات تصنيفية مناسبة للاعتماد")

```




```{r}
plot_one_cat <- function(nm){
  v <- clinical[[nm]]
  df <- data.frame(val=v)
  ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(val))) + geom_bar() +
    labs(title = nm, x=NULL, y="Count") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust=1))
}
top_cats <- head(shortlist$name, 6)
if(length(top_cats)){
  for(nm in top_cats) print(plot_one_cat(nm))
} else {
  message("لا يوجد متغيّرات تصنيفية مطابقة للشروط — جرّب تخفيف الشروط أو راجع الأعمدة.")
}

```




```{r}
num_dict <- subset(dict, type=="numeric")
# استبعد الأعمدة اللي شكلها ID/Batch
num_dict <- subset(num_dict, !is_batch_like(name) & !is_id_like(name))
# حد مفقود منطقي
num_dict <- subset(num_dict, missing_rate <= 0.2)
kable(head(num_dict[order(num_dict$missing_rate, -num_dict$unique_non_na), ], 20),
      caption="Numeric covariates (مرشّحة)")

```




```{r}
# meta خفيفة: (sample_id + shortlist columns + batch/type لو موجودين)
keep_cols <- unique(c("sample_id","type","batch", shortlist$name))
meta <- clinical[, intersect(keep_cols, names(clinical)), drop=FALSE]
if(!dir.exists(file.path(proc_dir,"clinical"))) dir.create(file.path(proc_dir,"clinical"), recursive = TRUE)
saveRDS(meta, file.path(proc_dir, "clinical", "meta_shortlist.rds"))
arrow::write_parquet(as.data.frame(meta), file.path(proc_dir, "clinical", "meta_shortlist.parquet"))

# كمان نحفظ الدكشنري
arrow::write_parquet(as.data.frame(dict), file.path(proc_dir, "clinical", "clinical_dictionary.parquet"))
saveRDS(dict, file.path(proc_dir, "clinical", "clinical_dictionary.rds"))

# عرض سطر تأكيد
nrow(meta); names(meta)

```




```{r}
# --- 0) تحضير ---
library(data.table); library(janitor); library(ggplot2); library(knitr)

source("R/workflow_utils.R")
cfg <- load_moda_paths()
base_dir <- cfg$external_project_dir
raw_dir  <- cfg$external_raw_dir
proc_dir <- cfg$external_processed_dir
if(!dir.exists(file.path(proc_dir,"clinical"))) dir.create(file.path(proc_dir,"clinical"), recursive = TRUE)

std_ids <- function(x){ x <- toupper(gsub("\\s+","", as.character(x))); gsub("[^A-Z0-9_-]","", x) }
common_samples <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "common_samples.rds"))

clin_path <- list.files(raw_dir, pattern="(?i)^Clinical.*\\.txt$|\\.tsi\\.txt$", full.names=TRUE)[1]
clinical <- fread(clin_path, data.table=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","NaN"))
names(clinical) <- make_clean_names(names(clinical))

# التعرّف على عمود العينة
cands <- c("sample_id","sample","aliquot","aliquot_id","experimental_sample_id",
           "case_id","subject_id","tumor_sample_barcode","biospecimen_id","sample_name")
present <- intersect(cands, names(clinical))
scores  <- sapply(present, function(col) sum(std_ids(clinical[[col]]) %in% std_ids(common_samples)))
best_col <- present[which.max(scores)]
clinical$sample_id <- std_ids(clinical[[best_col]])

clinical <- clinical[clinical$sample_id %in% std_ids(common_samples), , drop=FALSE]

# --- 1) إعادة الترميز الأساسية ---
# type
if("tissue_type_0nat_1tumor" %in% names(clinical)){
  clinical$type <- ifelse(clinical$tissue_type_0nat_1tumor %in% c(0,"0"), "NAT","Tumor")
} else if(!"type" %in% names(clinical)){
  stop("لم أجد عمود type/التصنيف النسيجي.")
}

# cohort كـ batch واقعي
if("luad_cohort" %in% names(clinical)) {
  clinical$cohort <- as.character(clinical$luad_cohort)
} else clinical$cohort <- NA_character_

# sex
if("gender_0female_1male" %in% names(clinical)){
  clinical$sex <- ifelse(clinical$gender_0female_1male %in% c(1,"1"), "Male", "Female")
}

# race collapsed
if("race" %in% names(clinical)){
  rc <- tolower(as.character(clinical$race))
  rc[!rc %in% c("asian","white","black")] <- "other"
  clinical$race_collapsed <- ifelse(rc %in% c("asian","white","black"), toupper(substr(rc,1,1)) %+% substr(rc,2,999), "Other")
}

# region (حافظ عليها كما هي)
if("region" %in% names(clinical)) clinical$region <- as.character(clinical$region)

# stage_full → stage_bin (Early vs Late)
if("stage_full" %in% names(clinical)){
  s <- toupper(gsub("\\s","", as.character(clinical$stage_full)))
  early <- c("1A","1B","2A","2B","I","II","STAGE1","STAGE2")
  late  <- c("3A","3B","3C","4","III","IV","STAGE3","STAGE4")
  stage_bin <- ifelse(s %in% early, "Early",
                 ifelse(s %in% late,  "Late", NA))
  clinical$stage_bin <- stage_bin
}

# EGFR: classic vs باقي
if("egfr_mutation_info" %in% names(clinical)){
  eg <- gsub("\\s+","", as.character(clinical$egfr_mutation_info))
  classic <- eg %in% c("Exon21.Leu858Arg","Exon19.Deletion")
  clinical$egfr_classic_vs_other <- ifelse(classic, "Classic", 
                                    ifelse(eg %in% c("No.Mutation","Other"), "NonClassic", NA))
  # خيار بديل: EGFR_any (أي طفرة) vs WT
  clinical$egfr_any_vs_wt <- ifelse(eg == "No.Mutation", "WT",
                             ifelse(!is.na(eg), "Mut", NA))
}

# N-stage: Npos vs N0
if("staging_pn" %in% names(clinical)){
  pn <- toupper(as.character(clinical$staging_pn))
  clinical$npos_vs_n0 <- ifelse(pn == "PN0", "N0",
                          ifelse(pn %in% c("PN1","PN2","PN3"), "Npos", NA))
}

# numeric covariates
clinical$age        <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(clinical$age))
clinical$tumor_size <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(clinical$tumor_size))
clinical$tmb        <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(clinical$tmb))

# TMB tertiles (لتجنّب cutoff ادعائي)
if(!all(is.na(clinical$tmb))){
  qs <- quantile(clinical$tmb, probs=c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm=TRUE)
  clinical$tmb_tertile <- cut(clinical$tmb, breaks=c(-Inf, qs[1], qs[2], Inf),
                              labels=c("Low","Mid","High"))
}

# --- 2) meta النهائي: احتفظ بما نحتاجه فقط ---
keep <- c("sample_id","type","cohort","sex","age","race_collapsed","region",
          "stage_bin","egfr_classic_vs_other","egfr_any_vs_wt","npos_vs_n0",
          "tumor_size","tmb","tmb_tertile")
meta <- clinical[, intersect(keep, names(clinical)), drop=FALSE]

# --- 3) ملخصات سريعة للعرض ---
count_tbl <- function(v) sort(table(v), decreasing=TRUE)
kable(as.data.frame(count_tbl(meta$type)),  caption="type counts")
if("stage_bin" %in% names(meta)) kable(as.data.frame(count_tbl(meta$stage_bin)), caption="stage_bin counts")
if("egfr_classic_vs_other" %in% names(meta)) kable(as.data.frame(count_tbl(meta$egfr_classic_vs_other)), caption="EGFR (Classic vs NonClassic)")
if("egfr_any_vs_wt" %in% names(meta)) kable(as.data.frame(count_tbl(meta$egfr_any_vs_wt)), caption="EGFR (Any vs WT)")
if("npos_vs_n0" %in% names(meta)) kable(as.data.frame(count_tbl(meta$npos_vs_n0)), caption="Npos vs N0")
kable(summary(meta$age), caption="Age summary")

plot_bar <- function(nm){
  if(!nm %in% names(meta)) return(invisible(NULL))
  df <- data.frame(val = meta[[nm]])
  ggplot(df, aes(x=factor(val))) + geom_bar() + labs(title=nm, x=NULL, y="Count") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust=1))
}
print(plot_bar("stage_bin")); print(plot_bar("egfr_classic_vs_other")); print(plot_bar("npos_vs_n0"))

# --- 4) حفظ ---
saveRDS(meta, file.path(proc_dir, "clinical", "meta_labels.rds"))
arrow::write_parquet(as.data.frame(meta), file.path(proc_dir, "clinical", "meta_labels.parquet"))

```
